vsm2.17:298.1: Tivaṭṭamanavaṭṭhitaṃ bhamatīti ettha pana saṅkhārabhavā kammavaṭṭaṃ, avijjātaṇhupādānāni kilesavaṭṭaṃ, viññāṇanāmarūpasaḷāyatanaphassavedanā vipākavaṭṭanti imehi tīhi vaṭṭehi tivaṭṭamidaṃ bhavacakkaṃ
vsm2.17:298.2: yāva kilesavaṭṭaṃ na upacchijjati, tāva anupacchinnapaccayattā anavaṭṭhitaṃ punappunaṃ parivattanato bhamatiyevāti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.17:299.2:
Saccappabhavato kiccā, vāraṇā upamāhi ca;
Gambhīranayabhedā ca, viññātabbaṃ yathārahaṃ.
vsm2.17:300.1: Tattha yasmā kusalākusalaṃ kammaṃ avisesena samudayasaccanti saccavibhaṅge vuttaṃ,
vsm2.17:300.2: tasmā avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti avijjāya saṅkhārā dutiyasaccappabhavaṃ dutiyasaccaṃ.
vsm2.17:300.9: Jātiyā jarāmaraṇaṃ paṭhamasaccappabhavaṃ paṭhamasaccanti evaṃ tāvidaṃ saccappabhavato viññātabbaṃ yathārahaṃ.
vsm2.17:301.1: Yasmā panettha avijjā vatthūsu ca satte sammoheti, paccayo ca hoti saṅkhārānaṃ pātubhāvāya.
vsm2.17:301.2: Tathā saṅkhārā saṅkhatañca abhisaṅkharonti, paccayā ca honti viññāṇassa.
vsm2.17:301.3: Viññāṇampi vatthuñca paṭivijānāti, paccayo ca hoti nāmarūpassa.
vsm2.17:301.4: Nāmarūpampi aññamaññañca upatthambheti, paccayo ca hoti saḷāyatanassa.
vsm2.17:301.5: Saḷāyatanampi savisaye ca pavattati, paccayo ca hoti phassassa.
vsm2.17:301.6: Phassopi ārammaṇañca phusati, paccayo ca hoti vedanāya.
vsm2.17:301.7: Vedanāpi ārammaṇarasañca anubhavati, paccayo ca hoti taṇhāya.
vsm2.17:301.8: Taṇhāpi rajjanīye ca dhamme rajjati, paccayo ca hoti upādānassa.
vsm2.17:301.9: Upādānampi upādāniye ca dhamme upādiyati, paccayo ca hoti bhavassa.
vsm2.17:301.10: Bhavopi nānāgatīsu ca vikkhipati, paccayo ca hoti jātiyā.
vsm2.17:301.11: Jātipi khandhe ca janeti tesaṃ abhinibbattibhāvena pavattattā, paccayo ca hoti jarāmaraṇassa.
vsm2.17:301.12: Jarāmaraṇampi khandhānaṃ pākabhedabhāvañca adhitiṭṭhati, paccayo ca hoti bhavantarapātubhāvāya sokādīnaṃ adhiṭṭhānattā.
vsm2.17:301.13: Tasmā sabbapadesu dvedhā pavattikiccatopi idaṃ viññātabbaṃ yathārahaṃ.
vsm2.17:302.1: Yasmā cettha avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti idaṃ kārakadassananivāraṇaṃ.
vsm2.17:302.4: Nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanantiādi attā passati…pe… vijānāti, phusati, vedayati, taṇhiyati, upādiyati, bhavati, jāyati, jīyati, mīyatītievamādidassananivāraṇaṃ.
vsm2.17:303.1: 658. Yasmā panettha salakkhaṇasāmaññalakkhaṇavasena dhammānaṃ adassanato andho viya avijjā.
vsm2.17:303.7: Ghaṭṭanadukkhaṃ viya phassapaccayā vedanā, dukkhassa paṭikārābhilāso viya vedanāpaccayā taṇhā.
vsm2.17:303.12: Yasmā vā panettha avijjā appaṭipattimicchāpaṭipattibhāvena satte abhibhavati paṭalaṃ viya akkhīni.
vsm2.17:303.13: Tadabhibhūto ca bālo punabbhavikehi saṅkhārehi attānaṃ veṭheti kosakārakimi viya kosappadesehi.
vsm2.17:303.14: Saṅkhārapariggahitaṃ viññāṇaṃ gatīsu patiṭṭhaṃ labhati pariṇāyakapariggahito viya rājakumāro rajje.
vsm2.17:303.15: Upapattinimittaparikappanato viññāṇaṃ paṭisandhiyaṃ anekappakāraṃ nāmarūpaṃ abhinibbatteti māyākāro viya māyaṃ.
vsm2.17:303.16: Nāmarūpe patiṭṭhitaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ pāpuṇāti subhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhito vanappagumbo viya.
vsm2.17:303.17: Āyatanaghaṭṭanato phasso jāyati araṇisahitābhimanthanato aggi viya.
vsm2.17:303.18: Phassena phuṭṭhassa vedanā pātubhavati agginā phuṭṭhassa dāho viya.
vsm2.17:303.19: Vedayamānassa taṇhā pavaḍḍhati loṇūdakaṃ pivato pipāsā viya.
vsm2.17:303.20: Tasito bhavesu abhilāsaṃ karoti pipāsito viya pānīye.
vsm2.17:303.21: Tadassupādānaṃ, upādānena bhavaṃ upādiyati āmisalobhena maccho baḷisaṃ viya.
vsm2.17:303.22: Bhave sati jāti hoti bīje sati aṅkuro viya.
vsm2.17:303.23: Jātassa avassaṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ uppannassa rukkhassa patanaṃ viya.
vsm2.17:303.24: Tasmā evaṃ upamāhipetaṃ bhavacakkaṃ viññātabbaṃ yathārahaṃ.
vsm2.17:304.1: 659. Yasmā ca bhagavatā atthatopi dhammatopi desanatopi paṭivedhatopi gambhīrabhāvaṃ sandhāya ‘‘gambhīro cāyaṃ, ānanda, paṭiccasamuppādo gambhīrāvabhāso cā’’ti (dī. ni. 2.95; saṃ. ni. 2.60) vuttaṃ,
vsm2.17:305.1: Tattha yasmā na jātito jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti, na ca jātiṃ vinā aññato hoti, itthañca jātito samudāgacchatīti evaṃ jātipaccayasamudāgataṭṭhassa duravabodhanīyato jarāmaraṇassa jātipaccayasambhūtasamudāgataṭṭho gambhīro.
vsm2.17:305.2: Tathā jātiyā bhavapaccaya…pe… saṅkhārānaṃ avijjāpaccayasambhūtasamudāgataṭṭho gambhīro.
vsm2.17:305.3: Tasmā idaṃ bhavacakkaṃ atthagambhīranti ayaṃ tāvettha atthagambhīratā.
vsm2.17:305.4: Hetuphalañhi atthoti vuccati. Yathāha – ‘‘hetuphale ñāṇaṃ atthapaṭisambhidā’’ti (vibha. 720).
vsm2.17:306.1: Yasmā pana yenākārena yadavatthā ca avijjā tesaṃ tesaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ paccayo hoti, tassa duravabodhanīyato avijjāya saṅkhārānaṃ paccayaṭṭho gambhīro.
vsm2.17:306.2: Tathā saṅkhārānaṃ…pe… jātiyā jarāmaraṇassa paccayaṭṭho gambhīro,
vsm2.17:306.3: tasmā idaṃ bhavacakkaṃ dhammagambhīranti ayamettha dhammagambhīratā.
vsm2.17:306.4: Hetuno hi dhammoti nāmaṃ. Yathāha – ‘‘hetumhi ñāṇaṃ dhammapaṭisambhidā’’ti (vibha. 720).
vsm2.17:307.1: Yasmā cassa tena tena kāraṇena tathā tathā pavattetabbattā desanāpi gambhīrā, na tattha sabbaññutaññāṇato aññaṃ ñāṇaṃ patiṭṭhaṃ labhati.
vsm2.17:307.2: Tathāhetaṃ katthaci sutte anulomato, katthaci paṭilomato, katthaci anulomapaṭilomato, katthaci vemajjhato paṭṭhāya anulomato vā paṭilomato vā,
vsm2.17:307.3: katthaci tisandhicatusaṅkhepaṃ, katthaci dvisandhitisaṅkhepaṃ, katthaci ekasandhidvisaṅkhepaṃ desitaṃ,
vsm2.17:307.4: tasmā idaṃ bhavacakkaṃ desanāgambhīranti ayaṃ desanāgambhīratā.
vsm2.17:308.1: Yasmā cettha yo so avijjādīnaṃ sabhāvo, yena paṭividdhena avijjādayo sammā salakkhaṇato paṭividdhā honti, so duppariyogāhattā gambhīro,
vsm2.17:308.13: jātiyā jāti sañjāti okkanti nibbatti pātubhāvaṭṭho,
vsm2.17:309.1: 660. Yasmā panettha ekattanayo, nānattanayo, abyāpāranayo, evaṃdhammatānayoti cattāro atthanayā honti,
vsm2.17:310.1: Tattha avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇanti evaṃ bījassa aṅkurādibhāvena rukkhabhāvappatti viya santānānupacchedo ekattanayo nāma.
vsm2.17:310.2: Yaṃ sammā passanto hetuphalasambandhena santānassa anupacchedāvabodhato ucchedadiṭṭhiṃ pajahati.
vsm2.17:310.3: Micchā passanto hetuphalasambandhena pavattamānassa santānānupacchedassa ekattagahaṇato sassatadiṭṭhiṃ upādiyati.
vsm2.17:311.2: Yaṃ sammā passanto navanavānaṃ uppādadassanato sassatadiṭṭhiṃ pajahati.
vsm2.17:311.3: Micchā passanto ekasantānapatitassa bhinnasantānasseva nānattaggahaṇato ucchedadiṭṭhiṃ upādiyati.
vsm2.17:312.1: Avijjāya saṅkhārā mayā uppādetabbā, saṅkhārānaṃ vā viññāṇaṃ amhehīti evamādibyāpārābhāvo abyāpāranayo nāma.
vsm2.17:312.2: Yaṃ sammā passanto kārakassa abhāvāvabodhato attadiṭṭhiṃ pajahati.
vsm2.17:312.3: Micchā passanto yo asatipi byāpāre avijjādīnaṃ sabhāvaniyamasiddho hetubhāvo, tassa aggahaṇato akiriyadiṭṭhiṃ upādiyati.
vsm2.17:313.1: Avijjādīhi pana kāraṇehi saṅkhārādīnaṃyeva sambhavo khīrādīhi dadhiādīnaṃ viya, na aññesanti ayaṃ evaṃdhammatānayo nāma.
vsm2.17:313.2: Yaṃ sammā passanto paccayānurūpato phalāvabodhā ahetukadiṭṭhiṃ akiriyadiṭṭhiñca pajahati.
vsm2.17:313.3: Micchā passanto paccayānurūpaṃ phalappavattiṃ aggahetvā yato kutoci yassa kassaci asambhavaggahaṇato ahetukadiṭṭhiñceva niyatavādañca upādiyatīti evamidaṃ bhavacakkaṃ,
vsm2.17:313.4:
Saccappabhavato kiccā, vāraṇāupamāhi ca;
Gambhīranayabhedā ca, viññātabbaṃ yathārahaṃ.
vsm2.17:314.1:
661. Idañhi atigambhīrato agādhaṃ. Nānānayagahanato duratiyānaṃ.
Ñāṇāsinā samādhipavarasilāyaṃ sunisitena,
Bhavacakkamapadāletvā, asanivicakkamiva niccanimmathanaṃ;
Saṃsārabhayamatīto, na koci supinantarepyatthi.
vsm2.17:314.2: Vuttampi hetaṃ bhagavatā – ‘‘gambhīro cāyaṃ, ānanda, paṭiccasamuppādo gambhīrāvabhāso ca.
vsm2.17:314.3: Etassa cānanda, dhammassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamayaṃ pajā tantākulakajātā kulāgaṇṭhikajātā muñjapabbajabhūtā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ nātivattatī’’ti (mahāva. 95; saṃ. ni. 2.60).
vsm2.17:314.4: Tasmā attano vā paresaṃ vā hitāya ca sukhāya ca paṭipanno avasesakiccāni pahāya,
vsm2.17:314.5:
Gambhīre paccayākārappabhede idha paṇḍito;
Yathā gādhaṃ labhethevamanuyuñje sadā satoti.
vsm2.17:314.6:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Paññābhāvanādhikāre
Paññābhūminiddeso nāma
Sattarasamo paricchedo.
